study type: Mixed methods exploratory study (interviews, survey, chart review)
exposure: Perceived sense of control associated with epidural use
cohort: The study included 12 pregnant and post-partum women for interviews, and 265 third-trimester pregnant women for a survey and chart review, all from Townsville, Australia.
finding: Epidural request in labour was predicted by primiparity, epidural experience, induction or augmentation of labour, and perceived sense of control associated with epidural use.
